title.en: Electric 80 and HBT80-16 share a code and not a pipe cell
title.zh: 电动80和 HBT80-16 共用代号，不共用管径格

description.en: Both pages print HBT80-1816-110. Electric 80 has no delivery-pipe diameter. HBT80-16 prints 100 / 125 mm. Output is 60 m³/h on Electric 80 and 50 m³/h on HBT80-16.
description.zh: 两页都印 HBT80-1816-110。电动80没有输送管内径。HBT80-16 印 100 / 125 mm。电动80的输送量是 60 m³/h，HBT80-16 是 50 m³/h。

h1.en: Electric 80 and HBT80-16, same printed code
h1.zh: 电动80与 HBT80-16，相同的印出代号

directAnswer.en: Electric 80 Concrete Pump and HBT80-16 Concrete Pump are two Xingtai pages that both print HBT80-1816-110. They are not one spare list. Only HBT80-16 prints a delivery-pipe inner diameter, 100 / 125 mm. Neither page prints a piston OD or a seal kit.
directAnswer.zh: 电动80型混凝土泵和 HBT80-16混凝土泵是邢台的两张页面，都印了 HBT80-1816-110。它们不是同一份配件清单。只有 HBT80-16 印了输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。两页都没有印活塞外径或密封套件。

body.en: Model Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110. Motor 110 kW. Output 60 m³/h. Maximum outlet pressure 40 MPa. Hopper 0.7 m³. Pumping distance 900 m / 300 m. Aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 140 double pump. Size 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Weight 6000 kg. Delivery pipe diameter: missing field. Piston and seal sizes: missing fields.
body.zh: 型号 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110。电机 110 kW。输送量 60 m³/h。最大出口压力 40 MPa。料斗 0.7 m³。输送距离 900 m / 300 m。骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。液压泵为川崎 140 双泵。外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。重量 6000 kg。输送管内径：缺字段。活塞和密封尺寸：缺字段。

body.en: Model HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110. Motor 110 kW. Output 50 m³/h. Pumping pressure 40 MPa. Horizontal conveying 120 m. Delivery height 360 m. Aggregate 4 cm and below. Delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm. Size 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm. Weight 6500 kg. The Kawasaki cell is on Electric 80, not on this HBT80-16 list. The straight pipe for HBT80-16 uses 100 / 125 mm. That cell does not move to Electric 80.
body.zh: 型号 HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110。电机 110 kW。输送量 50 m³/h。泵送压力 40 MPa。水平输送 120 m。输送高度 360 m。骨料 4 cm 及以下。输送管 100 / 125 mm。外形 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm。重量 6500 kg。川崎那一格在电动80上，不在这份 HBT80-16 清单里。HBT80-16 的直管用 100 / 125 mm。这一格不能挪到电动80。

heading.en: What a spare inquiry can say

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. For a straight pipe, name HBT80-16 if you are using the 100 / 125 mm cell. For Electric 80, say the pipe diameter is not printed. Wear-part ODs still have to be read on the machine. The hydraulic-pump name is not a spare SKU.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 直管若要用 100 / 125 mm 这一格，请写 HBT80-16。电动80要写明管径没有印出。易损件外径仍须在机器上读取。液压泵名称不是配件货号。

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h. HBT80-16 prints 50 m³/h.
answer.zh: 不是。电动80印 60 m³/h。HBT80-16 印 50 m³/h。

question.en: Can I order a Kawasaki 140 pump as a Pinjin spare page?
question.zh: 能把川崎 140 泵当成品锦配件页来订吗？

answer.en: No spare page for that hydraulic pump is published. The words appear as a specification cell on Electric 80.
answer.zh: 没有公布该液压泵的配件页。这几个字是电动80参数表里的一格。

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, via the contact page.
answer.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械，通过联系页。

label.en: Email or WhatsApp the Xingtai factory
label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
